title: pvHierarchicalFractal
body:
## pvHierarchicalFractal

Test source that builds a refined hierarchy of uniform (or rectilinear) grid blocks around a Mandelbrot-set fractal, with a cell array scaled to look like a material volume fraction (0.5 at FractalValue). It produces a composite, AMR-like dataset and exists to exercise AMR, ghost-level and material-interface filters, not to represent physical data. For an AMR test pulse use pvAMRGaussianPulseSource; for a single-block fractal use pvMandelbrot.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The output type differs with RectilinearGrids (hierarchical box versus multiblock, per the VTK class notes); check it before connecting type-specific filters.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `HierarchicalFractal`. Identity: `sources/HierarchicalFractal`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Asymetric` | If this property is set to 0, all the blocks will be the same size. If it is set to 1, an asymmetric dataset will be created: some blocks will have an X dimension that is larger by 2 units. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Dimensions` | This property specifies the X, Y, Z cell dimensions of a block. | `{"maximum":64,"minimum":2,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2` |
| `FractalValue` | The value of this property will be mapped to 0.5 for use as a volume fraction. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `GhostLevels` | This property specifies whether ghost levels should be generated at processor boundaries. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MaximumLevel` | This property specifies how many levels of refinement should be included in this hierarchical dataset. | `{"maximum":10,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `RectilinearGrids` | If this property is set to 1, the hierarchical dataset will contain rectilinear grids; otherwise it will contain uniform grids. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `TimeStep` | This property specifies the timestep to use for this dataset. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `TwoDimensional` | If this property is set to 1, the generated dataset will be 2D; otherwise it will be 3D. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
